text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E at a profit felt rewarding, but I should base future sales on expected risk and portfolio needs, not the satisfaction of locking in gains.","My account value has fallen from its Period 5 peak, so I should avoid reacting to recent losses alone and stay focused on a consistent plan.","I should review whether my holdings remain appropriately diversified and preserve cash for flexibility, while remembering that past price changes do not predict future returns."]}
